label: Everything needed to draw and fly a JVTO route on Mapbox, in one file

source_trace.ref: postgres: routes, route_details, locations, destination_assets, assets
source_trace.field: stops, order, coordinates, photos, activity text

note: Self-contained: a consumer needs this file and a Mapbox token, nothing else. Regenerate with `npm run export:ekosistem` in jvto-cms when a route, a coordinate, or a photo changes.

usage.draw: Render routes[].geometry as a LineString source; split at current progress to colour travelled vs remaining.
usage.fly: Walk progress 0 to 1 over map_config.fly_duration_ms at constant speed, halting at each stop whose pause is true.
usage.stop_progress: stops[].progress is that stop position along geometry, 0 to 1, taken from the cumulative leg distance at construction. Use it to seek, to halt, and to fill the connector between two stops.
usage.off_route_km: Present on a stop whose coordinate sits more than 1 km from the drivable line — a crater or a beach the road does not reach. Its marker will not sit on the line.
